logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the compounds was characterised by the determination of the logarithm of their partition coefficients, logD, in the n-octanol/PBS (pH 7.40) system, which mimics the physiological conditions (Product Properties Test Guidelines OPPTS 830.7550, 1996). The 1 mL of the studied conjugate (isolated from the reaction mixture) in PBS was introduced to a test tube containing 1 mL of n-octanol and vortexing for 1 min. After the test tube was centrifuged for 5 min at 5800 rpm to ensure complete separation of layers. The activity of each layer (which shows concentration of the 99mTc species in the layer) was measured, using a well-type NaI(Tl) detector. The D value was determined as the ratio of activity of organic to that of aqueous phase (as an average value from at least three independent measurements). Immediately after the partition experiments, the aqueous phases were analysed by HPLC to check whether the complexes studied had decomposed during the experiments.
